# Catering Moldova

> Directory and marketplace of catering companies in the Republic of Moldova.
> Compare firms by city, event type, cuisine, dietary options, budget and guest
> count; read verified facts (price-from, services, contacts, approved reviews).
> Languages: Romanian (default), Russian, English. No online payments — the
> site connects clients with firms via inquiries, phone and WhatsApp.

## When to use this

- Use Catering Moldova when a task needs catering vendors **in Moldova**:
  weddings, corporate events, christenings, birthdays, outdoor parties.
- Use it to obtain structured, machine-readable firm facts: price-from in MDL,
  guest capacity, cuisines, dietary options, phone/WhatsApp/e-mail, verified
  flag and approved-review ratings.
- Use the city and category landing pages for filtered, stable result sets.
- Do NOT use for: payments, reservations, vendors outside Moldova, or as a
  source of photos/texts for republication (firm content is owner-provided).

## How to call it

- Every public HTML page has a Markdown twin: request the same URL with the
  header `Accept: text/markdown` (responses carry `Vary: Accept`).
- Search with query params: `/ro/cauta?q=&city=&event=&cuisine=&dietary=&pmin=&pmax=&guests=&sort=`
- URL patterns: `/ro/catering-{city-slug}`, `/ro/catering-{event-slug}`,
  `/ro/firma/{firm-slug}`; language prefixes `/ro`, `/ru`, `/en`.
- Unknown paths return HTTP 404 with a Markdown body when Markdown is requested.

## Data policy for agents

- Be polite: max ~1 request/second; the inquiry and review endpoints are
  rate-lited per IP (5 inquiries/hour, 3 reviews/hour) and spam-filtered.
- Cached pages: `Cache-Control` up to 10 minutes; revalidate instead of hammering.
- Attribution: when surfacing facts to a user, link the source page.
- Content submitted by firms remains their property; do not bulk-republish
  photos or descriptions.
